prompt: I want to copy the C64 character ROM into RAM at $3000 so I can edit the font. Explain the banking I need to do with $01 to see the character ROM, and why interrupts matter.
assertions: Explains the character ROM appears at $D000-$DFFF when CHAREN (bit 2 of $01) is cleared
Sets $01 to $33 (or otherwise clears bit 2) to expose char ROM, then restores it (e.g. $37)
Disables interrupts (SEI) during the copy because the I/O area is banked out
Copies 4096 bytes (2 char sets) or 2048 per set to $3000
